segments.text: The Little Minx Who's Head Over Heels for Her Big Brother
"Onii-chan is mine and mine alone! I'll never let another girl steal him away."

Meet Rena: a sister with eyes only for her brother and gives everyone else the cold shoulder. She's a master at pushing all the right buttons when getting guys flustered - and she knows it. Fresh into her first year, she's dead set on making her big bro fall head over heels for her. Oh, and that whole rivalry with Akiha? They're actually drinking buddies when they're not competing for his attention.
On Dating:
"If both parties are having fun, who are we to judge? So don't get in the way of my brother and me, okay~♪"
Charm Points:
Her affection for her big brother is genuine, no matter how much she tries to deny it.
Character Gap:
All that flirty confidence melts away when someone turns the tables on her.
Based on the official site

男性の動揺するシチュエーションを熟知しており、今年１年生でありながら、本気でお兄ちゃんを落とそうと狙っている。
秋葉とは良い喧嘩仲間であり恋のライバル。
「お兄ちゃんは私にだけモテていれば良いのー。
他の子には絶対に渡さないんだから」

The Pure-Hearted Tsundere Next Door
“Whoa, time out! Making a baby with your own sister? That’s just wrong on so many levels! I mean, I’m RIGHT HERE - and actually legal!”

Akiha is not just any childhood friend—she’s been part of our hero and his sister Rena’s lives since the beginning. Their paths have been intertwined from day one, sharing the same birth hospital and kindergarten in what seems like destiny’s master plan. That same fate must have been working overtime because she ended up living next door.
Having harbored feelings for him all these years, Akiha finds herself in a perpetual rivalry with Rena for his affection.
On Dating:
“Whatever. They’re all a bunch of idiots. Seriously, making out like there’s no tomorrow right in front of the station—gimme a break!”
Charm Points:
A classic tsundere - she’s head-over-heels but totally can’t admit it.
Character Gap:
When her guard drops, you catch glimpses of the refined, sincere girl she used to be.
Based on the official site

segments.text: The Soothing Sweetheart: A Playful Transfer Student
"Uh, um…! This mochi looks exactly like my pet hamster! It’s way too cute to eat…!"
A stunning transfer student who's both impishly playful and naturally demure - that's Frederica.

Our protagonist quickly discovers she's the perfect target: tease her and you'll either get an adorably flustered reaction or the most precious responses imaginable. These daily doses of playful torment have become her secret weapon for fitting in - now known as "Fren" to her classmates, she's found her place through these interactions.
Fresh off her transfer but already assigned to the seat next to our hero, she's beginning to feel those delicate stirrings of romance.
On Dating:
"W-well, who am I to judge if two people are happy being lovey-dovey? Though I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous."
Charm Points
Takes jealousy to a whole new level
Character Gap
Get on her bad side, and you'll learn the hard way - she can hold a grudge like nobody's business

"You guys are way too close...!! You and Rena-chan have absolutely no concept of personal space...!?"

Second year at Seiryou Academy, the protagonist's trusty classmate and childhood friend, who has been by his side since they were kids. Call it fate or just bad luck, but they've been stuck together like glue – same school, same class, two years running.
Kouta's also got history with Kurumi Akiha from their old school, making him one of the rare souls who can actually decode her personality.

Like the protagonist, he's perfected the art of social shapeshifting – floating right in the middle of the school hierarchy, seamlessly switching between party mode and wallflower depending on what the situation calls for.
Fun fact: everyone treats him like their personal stress ball, but somehow he seems to love every second of it.
